Count Seutorian

Original: https://shrouded-lands.fandom.com/wiki/Count_Seutorian

**Family: **Seutorians. Count Seutorian is uncle of Lucin Seutorian and Cliffar Seutorian (11.03)

Connections

*The Count funded Lucin’s disastrous production of The Song of Ban and Ulena (39.12)

*The Count’s hot-air balloon looks like Baron Harenghast’s mother.

*Count Seutorian keeps a large flock of peacockatrices in his gardens and often meditates while staring into their feathers (while on the other side of a stout wrought iron fence, as he is not an idiot).

*One of the Count’s current guests is the orc Brigadier Kalas Montra-brey, who Seutorian provides with assistance in his hunts in return for a promise of an elf slave of his very own, if Kalas can find one that meets his specifications.

*The Count bought the Blind Doge his talking pocket watch from Albus Flidge. Category:Nobles Category:The Shuttered City Category:Seutorians
